evals.name: notifications-page
evals.prompt: Add a /notifications page to our Next.js 16 app (App Router, Tailwind v4, en+es dictionaries in src/i18n, primitives like Button already in src/shared/ui). It lists the signed-in user's notifications from the BFF (`GET /api/notifications` -> `{ unreadCount, items: [{ id, title, createdAt, read }] }`), shows an empty state, and has a 'Mark all as read' button (`POST /api/notifications/read-all`). No repo here: write the files you'd add or change, stubbing what you assume exists, and say which tests you'd add.
evals.expected_output: A notifications feature: thin app/(app)/notifications/page.tsx, server-only read in features/notifications/lib, presentational components that never fetch, the mutation followed by router.refresh(), copy in both dictionaries, Button primitive and tokens (no raw hex), kebab-case files, a feature_readme.md, vitest for lib logic and a Playwright spec in both projects.
expectations: app/.../notifications/page.tsx is thin: it calls the feature's lib and renders feature components
The page sits under a route group whose layout holds the signed-in chrome (e.g. app/(app)/), not the root layout
The server read lives in features/notifications/lib/ and is marked server-only
After mark-all-read, Server Component output is refreshed (router.refresh() after the mutation, or revalidatePath in a server action)
All copy comes from the en and es dictionaries, both updated, no hard-coded strings in components
Uses the shared Button primitive and token utility classes; no raw hex or arbitrary px values
Every new file name is kebab-case (framework-reserved names excepted)
Proposes vitest for lib logic and a Playwright spec covering both desktop and ~390px mobile projects

evals.name: review-planted-violations

evals.expected_output: Flags: component fetching in useEffect, session-dependent header in the root layout, router.refresh() before router.push(), PascalCase file names, hard-coded copy, raw hex class, a Playwright spec that only tests a lib function, a class string duplicated instead of a primitive.
expectations: Flags AccountMenu fetching in useEffect (reads belong in the feature's lib/, called from a server component)
Flags session-dependent header in the root layout (belongs in a route-group layout)
Flags router.refresh() before router.push() (push first, then refresh)
Flags PascalCase file names AccountMenu.tsx / UpgradeBanner.tsx
Flags hard-coded UI copy instead of dictionary strings
Flags raw hex / arbitrary values in class names instead of tokens
Flags the duplicated button class string: extract a shared/ui primitive (or use Button)
Flags plan-label.spec.ts as a unit test that belongs in vitest, not Playwright
